name: Nasdaq Data Link
tagline: Market and alternative datasets via REST from Nasdaq Data Link
description: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl) provides a REST API for time-series and table datasets covering markets, economics, and alternative data. Developers authenticate with an API key, query named datasets, and receive JSON or CSV for analysis, backtesting, and research workflows.

auth.details: API key via the api_key query parameter (api_key=YOUR_API_KEY); free self-serve signup at data.nasdaq.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Authenticated non-premium: 300 calls/10s, 2,000 calls/10 min, 50,000 calls/day; concurrency 1 (one in-flight + one queued). Anonymous: 20 calls/10 min and 50/day.
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and subscription plans for premium datasets and higher limits

rate_limits: Non-premium authenticated: 300/10s, 2,000/10 min, 50,000/day, concurrency 1. Premium (tables sub): 5,000/10 min, 720,000/day. Anonymous: 20/10 min, 50/day. Bulk export: 60/hour.

example.response_snippet: {"datatable":{"data":[[...]],"columns":[{"name":"...","type":"..."}]},"meta":{"next_cursor_id":null}} (tables JSON shape; live rows require a free API key—endpoint returns QEPx04 without key, not 410)

use_cases: fetch historical stock OHLCV for a ticker
export table datasets to CSV for analysis
backtest strategies with historical market data
